reviews.title: Not to be Trusted
reviews.text: Not to be Trusted We booked and was given confirmation later t find out that four persons out of the party of eight were cancelled. When this was queried we were then told that the Airline had changed its schedule and could not fly us on the scheduled day (Saturday) but would be able to do so on the Monday only to be later told that they could not fly us and would give a refund. Fast forward 8 months and now we are told we cannot get a refund and we could use the Tickets but would have to do so by August (which would be the end of the valid period for the tickets. Now we are told that they no longer fly from our home port (Barbados) and we would have to pick-up the fare to Antigua and then use WinAir from there to our original destination of St Martin. Needless to say we will never ever book flights on WInAir again and we will advise all friends and family against using the airline.
reviews.author: TonyBds

reviews.title: I would not recommend
reviews.text: So our flight was delayed approx 45 min. We were told the drew had not arrived yet. Let’s not mention it was roaches on the chair and a big one that went into my daughters open book bag I almost caught a heart attack. The plane is also very small and tight. I’m not a big person and it was still hard to move. I killed a baby roach on the chair in front of me.
reviews.author: Alicia

reviews.title: Satisfactory service
reviews.text: We flew WinAir from the BVI to Sint Maarten (not many airline choices from the BVI). The staff were very courteous and had no problems checking in our luggage. Online check-in didn't work for us for some reason but we checked in normally at the desk and had no issues. Around 10 minutes before our flight was scheduled to leave, we were escorted to the plane and left on time, and arrived earlier than expected at our destination. Space is quite limited on the aircraft so we had a small bag with us as our cabin bag. Overall, we had a good experience flying with WinAir.
reviews.author: VDecel

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: Winair airline is one of the slowest worst airlines in history, I can’t believe this airline still making money very incompetent and ridiculous. I DON’T RECOMMEND at all zero stars
reviews.author: Precious456
reviews.route: St. Kitts - St Martin / St Maarten

reviews.title: Lousy communication, some of the aircraft used are very old
reviews.text: On this flight, we had a very old and worn out Twin Otter - worn out everything. But arrived at Beef intact. So that´s a real plus! Communication of the airline is lousy, though. An earlier flight was cancelled without comments or any ambition to care for the customers. Had to sit 7 hours in one of the lousiest airports in the world for the evening flight.
reviews.author: jasondayo

reviews.title: Bad staff, changed flights with no notice, incomptent.
reviews.text: This is a ridiculous way to run an airline. Flew with them Feb 21 and dealt with untrained and then terrible supervisors (who prefer to play on their phones). Then Feb 22 dealt with totally inept system
reviews.author: tabhauser

reviews.title: Terrible Airline.  Ruined my vacation and didn't care
reviews.text: We flew on Winair from St. Maarten to St. Eustatius a few weeks ago. It was supposed to be a 5 day vacation on a beautiful island. Two days into our vacation, we were notified that our return flight had been cancelled. IN fact all of the flights the day of our return were cancelled. We were then told we had been rebooked on a flight 2 days earlier than planned. Winair stole 2 days from our vacation which we had been planning on for over a year. We then had to pay additional expenses of $850 to stay in St. Maarteen. When I spoke to their customer service and told them how much it cost us and how they stole 2 days from our vacation, they did nothing. No refund, no vouchers for future flights, NOTHING. Winair is a terrible airline that is managed poorly and does not care about their customers. Do yourself a favor and DO NOT FLY ON WINAIR.
reviews.author: Bob A
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Eustatius

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Worst experience ever in my life. So rude and it was like these people were sent from Satan's gates to make people believe that the darkest experiences of life can get darker.
reviews.author: Cody S

reviews.title: Worst Airline. EVERYBODY KNOWS THE RULES
reviews.text: Good morning Shocking service Shocking review Everybody knows the rules. Don’t mess the lord around.
reviews.author: James D

reviews.title: Worst Airline. Everybody knows the rules.
reviews.text: Worst Airline. Everybody knows the rules. This is a perfect airline for Mike Rapaport. That went well.

reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: We arrived into sxm with a little delay. We got to the winair counter and were met by Shanyna. We missed our connection so she put us in the next flight. The passport and security lines were so long but she helped us to make sure we didn’t miss the flight. I’m so grateful for her help and her smile.
reviews.author: Karim S
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Horrible !
reviews.text: A bunch of bran**** who don't want to work, don't give any information and send you off, and above all forget to load the luggage in the hold (transfer) on the way there and back! Many delay. Simply deplorable.
reviews.author: Théo D
reviews.route: St. Barthelemy - St Martin / St Maarten

reviews.title: 5star concierge service
reviews.text: We booked the 5star travel concierge service through WinAir one week ago when we were connecting through SXM to SBH from American Airlines. The WinAir 5star representative who met us was very pleasant and professional. We emailed all of our travel documents including EHAS form prior to day of travel. We were through immigration and customs in 15 minutes. They rep stayed with us until we checked in and boarded our flight to SBH. The cost was roughly 500euro but well worth it for my group of 8 travelers. Some of our luggage did not make our flight but was later delivered to our villa in St. Barths. Overall, I was very pleased.
reviews.author: coblewl
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: This airline needs to be closed down
reviews.text: My flight from St Maarten to St Kitts has been cancelled one hours before the flight because of the rain. The staff told me that IT'S NOT THEIR PROBLEM TO HELP ME and that I need to find a hotel and come back in the morning for the next flight. No compensation and no apologies (of course). Unfortunately they have the upper hand because they are the only airline in the region and like everyone else on this page, I will most likely not be seeing a penny. If you can, swim or take a ferry and avoid this nightmare of an airline, you should do it as much as possible. Diabolical how something like this is allowed in 2022.
reviews.author: Shycourgette
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Kitts

reviews.title: Scandalous ! Disrespectful !  Contemptuous ! Dishonest !
reviews.text: First, 2 weeks before, Winair cancelled our flight in the middle of the day, for transit of our flight to Europe at 5 PM on 31rst of january. They told us we had to fly at 7:40 AM, wich they confirmed. Afterwards, 2 days before, they cancelled also this flight, so we had to fly the previous day and stay one night in Saint-Martins, with no compensation proposed. For Winair, respect of contract is an option, and you merit no apology if they don't. Scandalous behavour, unforgivable and unacceptable ! Dishonest !
reviews.author: Christophe R
reviews.route: St. Eustatius - St Martin / St Maarten

reviews.title: Flier Beware...
reviews.text: My wife and I had a really terrible experience with them recently. We checked in for our flight online. Then checked our bags at the counter. After tagging our bags, they told us our flight was cancelled and that we had to take the ferry. As if that wasn't bad enough - upon follow up they refused to refund our fare, only issuing a travel voucher. Their explanation was that they cancelled our flight and therefore have the right to put all passengers on the earlier flight. It's really an insane policy. Terrible customer experience. But I guess that's what happens when you have a monopoly.
reviews.author: Miso Lu
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Completely unprofessional
reviews.text: Winair refused to honor a credit we had from a Covid cancellation. Customer service simply ignored our several requests.
reviews.author: Dan K
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Never ever ever fly this “airline”
reviews.text: The absolute worst experience with any airline in history. Connected in St Martin to get to St Barths. There is one gate for Winair. It was being serviced by about 6 women that couldn’t have been more rude if they tried. No information about upcoming flight, nothing on the monitors. If we asked questions we were either completely ignored or met with “can’t you see I’m busy” and a hand in my face. When we finally went to board we found out our plane was broken and we had to leave the airport to catch a ferry. Again completely rude and unhelpful. I had to beg the manager to try and get out bags. She was telling us just to go get the ferry and they would get our bags to us. We finally get to the ferry station and nobody from winair followed, so they did not want to give us ferry tickets without paying. We understand problems occur, but the employees of this airline just did not care. Insult to injury, they managed to lose my bag in the 3 hours we were held hostage by this airline and had no way of tracking my bag . I had to come to the st baths airport after every flight coming in the next day to see if it might make it. It finally did. Never. Ever. Fly. This. “Airline”.
reviews.author: Jeff H
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: The worst airlines ever
reviews.text: Our Experience on the 31st October at the V.C. Bird International Airport, Antigua. We were all set to fly back to India for good. We reached the airport 2 hours prior check in. Our first flight was with WIN AIR to St. Maarten. After arriving at the airport we were informed to fill out an online pre-approval COVID-19 form for St. Maarten to transit. WIN AIR land staffs did the form filling for us and asked us to check our email for the pre-approval. Also we sent an email to St Maarten authority immediately to send us the approval. Within 10 minutes, we received the approval for my daughter’s application. We waited for ours to come as well. It didn’t. We asked the WIN AIR team for assistance. They kept on telling us to wait. We explained them that we were leaving Antigua for good. They paid no attention to what we said. Just kept on telling us ‘WAIT’. Time was ticking. We had all required COVID test documents with us and had shown everything to the WIN AIR. As the boarding time neared, the WIN AIR staffs directly communicated with the St. Maarten authorities over phone. We pleaded them to let us talk to the St. Maarten people. But NO. The entire WIN AIR team was extremely unprofessional, rude and hostile to our situation. They told us to let our 9 years old daughter travel all by herself to India!!! We were shocked. They further told us that they can only allow us (myself and my wife) to take the evening flight to St Maarten. But by that time we can’t catch our connecting flights anymore!!! So they suggested that me and my wife stay in St Maarten for 5 days at our own cost and then fly again to India! Such irresponsible suggestions!!! Then they just left us there and we couldn't board the flight. Now when we asked them to reschedule our flight on the next available connecting flights day (5th Nov) WIN AIR informed us that tickets are not available on that day and so they cannot reschedule the flight or even give us any refund money. So we lost all our travel tickets just because of WIN AIR's uncooperative behavior. Further to the new ticket costs, we had to redo all our COVID tests for the new travel days, spend additional cost of 5 days stay at Antigua and so much of emotional stress. Who is going to pay me for all these harassment??? WIN AIR this was my worst experience in any airlines till date. I strongly recommend that everyone think twice before thinking of traveling with WinAir. What we went through, I don't want anyone ever to go through this hassle ever. If they wanted they could have easily helped us by communicating our desperate situation to St. Maarten team. We ourselves saw many people travelling without the approval in our next day of journey and they did the approval at the airport itself. The worst airline ever!!!!!! All this could have easily been sorted out if WINAIRhad been a little understanding. Actually there nothing less than 1 star to give them. They deserve zero and Big one. WINAIR #winair
reviews.author: Sushreeta S

reviews.title: Do not use WinAir
reviews.text: Do not fly with Winair. I bought a ticket through their website from Santo Domingo to St. Maarten and they cancelled the flight without any notice and without explanation, leaving my dog and I stranded at the airport for hours. Our 2 day travel turned into 6 days because we had to book extra hotels, another Covid Test, missed our ferry ride and more than a handful of taxis, plus the money spent for food over that week. They will not reimburse me for those expenses and claim that it wasn't their fault because the plane was with Air Antilles even though there was nothing on the website or ticket claiming so. When we finally got another scheduled flight, they made me pay all over again for the dog fees even though they were all paid for with receipts. If you can find another airline, do so.
reviews.author: Nikola D
reviews.route: Santo Domingo - St Martin / St Maarten

reviews.title: The worst airline I have ever travelled with
reviews.text: On my flight on July 14th from Curaçao to St. Maarten they just decided to leave literally half of the passengers bags in Curaçao due to “overloading”. Upon landing, I felt sorry for the people representing Winair as this is a common practice apparently. We were advised that they will do anything possible to bring our bags within 2 days. Just imagine, people with families on holiday, people with connecting flights like me. The outcome of this awful adventure was that I received my bag 37 days later, yes, 37 days later in Antigua. Customer service in their website is pretty much non existent, phone numbers are just mentioned, but no one is really there either. Thankfully, I got the Whats app number of the ground service in St. Maarten and that was my way to reunite with my bag. Of course, I did request a compensation, because I did spend quite of amount of money to buy everything I need while waiting for my luggage. I am still waiting for response for that matter, but I am sure it will take forever to find a solution. I am frequent traveler, due to my work, and this is the worst airline I have ever used. Reading the reviews online, I can tell my experience it is not a single case, but rather a practice of Winair. Avoid this airline if you want to have a peaceful and smooth travel whilst on your holiday. Winair, you should be ashamed of yourself!
reviews.author: Biser D

reviews.title: WORST travel experience EVER!!!!
reviews.text: On 10 May 2021 I had the misfortune of traveling on Winair to Dominica. After check in was complete and we were boarding on the RUNWAY we were RUDELY instructed that ours and another couple’s luggage would not be traveling with us and would “maybe” arrive on Thursday!!!??? We had to BEG to remove as many items as we could to carry in our HANDS and were told to rapidly grab them which resulted in my underwear, toothbrush, sanitary pads and clothes flying all over the RUNWAY!!!! After reporting Winair’s attitude to their marketing manager there has been ZERO follow up on the whereabouts of our luggage or when it may or may not arrive!!!!!!!! So here I sit in Dominica with no luggage after saving up for a year for this life time vacation! Winairs attitude is NOTHING SHORT OF DISGRACEFUL! I do so hope that people refrain from using Winair because I wouldn’t want anyone to go through what we have experienced with them.
reviews.author: Tracy d

reviews.title: Do not Trust WinAir.
reviews.text: What a terrible experience dealing with WinAir. They some how lost my luggage on a day when the airport was very empty and very few people on my flight. The staff was completely useless there only statement to me: Someone must have taken the wrong bag and will probably return it. Weird because I was first one off the plane and waiting at baggage claim. Here I am 5 days later with no luggage, no answers. I have had to hire an outside luggage concierge to investigate. How does a company fail so hard and oh so often when you carry such few passengers per flight? I’m pretty sure they have a behind the scenes theft ring happening targeting the st. Barths flights. Nothing makes sense on there end. Do not trust WinAir. Do not Fly with them.
reviews.author: Michael O
reviews.route: St. Barthelemy - St Martin / St Maarten

reviews.title: Irresponsable and abusive
reviews.text: On dec 4 my son and wife supposed to travel to st. Marteen to a connecting flight, without explanation they and 5 other passengers were left stranded at BCV airport, this airline is one NOT to be used as this is not the first time a rude and abusive attitude is displayed from their ground personnel.
reviews.author: Juan B is

reviews.title: Cheap, Cheap, Cheap
reviews.text: Horrible experience! WinAir is cheap in every sense of the word. We booked our flights months ago and had to cancel because the three COVID tests that EHAS of St. Martin's requires for entry were not offered in our area of Atlanta. Though we had a NEGATIVE test result, the manufacturer of the tests (which are used all across the continental United States) were not acceptable. So, we could not land on the island to catch a connecting flight. Therefore, we had to choose an alternate route to get to St. Bart's through San Juan. Regardless, WinAir didn't give a damn. They would not refund the $650 for two tickets. Moreover, the person handling reservations was rude and repetitive, non-helpful and dis-compassionate. She couldn't have cared less. We will never book again using WinAir, and we will discourage anyone we know from using their service (or lack thereof).
reviews.author: Randy R
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: LOSER Air
reviews.text: I have flown a handful of regional Caribbean carriers (LIAT, Divi Divi, Seaborne, Maya Air, Tradewinds) and Seaborne has long held the title for my worst Caribbean airline experience. Just when I thought this title could not be challenged even by the likes of LIAT, in comes Winair ready to be the belle of the ball of disastrous regional airlines. Let’s start from the beginning. We landed in SXM ready to transfer onward to SBH. Now I’ve heard a list of conspiracies about using the transfer desk at SXM (no boarding pass, ferry to Anguilla, depends who you get it etc) so I decided to spin the wheel. Unfortunately, a disgruntled Winair rep yelled at me for not having a boarding pass and demanded I go back and clear customs etc despite just transferring. No worries. I made a nice layover cushion precisely for this reason. As I waddled back back to clear customs I noticed a nice line of happy St Bart’s Commuter Air customers going through the transfer line greeted with happy workers showing them the way. Must be nice! After clearing customs I located a sign for Winair in the main departure hall and a jovial worked asked me where I was going and to stand in line. Nice, things were looking up. Once to the front of the line I went to the desk and was told by a woman in a Winair shirt “you’re in the wrong line” LOL what. She then told me to move four feet to my left where I was ignored for about ten minutes as the multiple workers had conversations amongst themselves. Behind them I saw a pile of 100+ bags where the workers were fighting amongst themselves about what bags where supposed to go where. Very reassuring for my bag to soon join that pile. Finally getting the boarding pass and having our bags checked we went through security. Upon boarding the flight it was discovered an extra person was on the plane. This lead to a game of attendance where there was a mix up in reservations /passengers and resulted in one woman being taken off the flight and a bit of a hostile exchange. Awkward. Short flight into St. Bart’s. Upon getting to baggage claim it was time for the big reveal: of a flight of less than 20 people probably about half of the people luggage arrived! Ta da! This clearly happens frequently as there are signs advising people to “contact the airline” and not bother the customs agent. The Winair worker said it happens ALL the time and to come back for your bags “later”. I can’t imagine for people in St Bart’s who did not rent cars how this would play out. Anyway we got our rental car, checked into the villa, went food shopping and returned to the airport. At this point ONLY ONE BAG of our two was there. We waited and waited and eventually my bag made it on the last flight of the day. Instead of a nice evening walk on the beach I got spend my first few hours in the airport wondering if I would even be able to change. Now for the flight home. Well it didn’t happen! With all the covid drama going down I had to reroute due to the fact SXM was closing down. I asked Winair via email for a refund or (holds in gag) a credit. They said they would credit me. I provided my information and went back and forth for two days. First they could not find me in their system despite prior emails and confirmation numbers. This kept occurring and I provided them all of my personal info short of my blood type. The day I got physically home Winair told me “Go contact chase” just lovely. NOW FOLKS GOING TO ST. BARTS, if you want to be treated humanely and have a smoother experience it seems that St. Bart’s commuter is a much better experience and the way to go. The transfer line alone would have me using them. Their price was cheaper as well. Coming home I used Tradewinds via SJU and the experience was exceptional and seamless though a lot more expensive (a separate review I have in TA). For those of you who do decide to use Winair.... well good luck!
reviews.author: IcedMacchiato
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Great little company
reviews.text: I flu with Winair 3 times and they were all pleasant and comfortable. Twice they put me on an earlier flight avoid us to wait at the airport. I highly reccomend them to hop around french west indies.
reviews.author: Lorenzo Lanari
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Mostly reliable inter-island, but antisocial flight times
reviews.text: We visited Curacao, Bonaire and Aruba. There are no inter-island ferries therefore flying is the only way. There are a range of carriers mainly with tiny aircraft, also an issue with financial stability with a couple of them. Divi Divi Air runs lots of flights but we found it impossible to book seats in advance from Europe on the Divi Divi website. In the Dutch Antilles it looked as if Divi flights were booked in person at airports prrsenting passports and payment. This left WinAir who primarily fly between ABCs and St Maarten on ATR42 aircraft with inter-island feeder flights between the islands. No business class, no seat assignments, no onboard service and flight times are either early (ie depart 0830 but with a 3hr checkin for an "international" 20 minute flight!!), or late evening arrival. All to fit in with the main SXM-CUR or SXM-AUA longer range flights. Two of our 3 WinAir inter-island flights ran on time, one was 40 minutes late arriving in Bonaire. Seats are basic with a 2+2 layout and the ticketed hold bag allowance might be 23kg, despite the website claiming only 20kg. We flew with 22kg each with no argument.
reviews.author: Christopher M

reviews.title: Good Flight
reviews.text: On-time flights, good service, everything went smoothly. Would recommend! Flew from Bonaire to Sint Maarten with a stop in Curacao. The time spent on the ground in Curacao isn't long, flight was comfortable. If you have the option, would recommend travelling with carry-ons only. Seems like a lot of other reviews here deal with baggage being left behind.
reviews.author: CaribbeanTraveller

reviews.title: Flight Cancelled without notification
reviews.text: Recently, while traveling to Bonaire and Curacao, Winair cancelled my flight without notifying me, even though they had all of my contact info. When I went to check in for the flight, they said they had cancelled it. I then had to book and pay for a second flight. I sent emails with the information to their customer service to try to get reimbursement for the flight, and they never replied. I'll fly Divi Divi next time. they are much more reliable!
reviews.author: gboyachuk

reviews.title: Booking confusion!!
reviews.text: Flight St Maarten to St Barthelemy no prob. On return previously booked flight had "disappeared" from system, in the end had to text travel arranger in London to contact Winair !! Please note Winair staff totally disinterested, as were our ongoing airline Ir France.
reviews.author: Peter T
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: After arriving without my bag (I checked it in 5 hours before my flight!), I continue to get a runaround when I tried to call to find out where it is, and when it will get here. It is only a 30 minute flight, but here I am on the third day of my vacation and still without my luggage OR any response from the airline other than (maybe it will be on the next flight). At one point, my hotel concierge and I couldn’t get them to even answer the phone for more than half a day ... they just let it ring! Never again.
reviews.author: Fahmy M
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Kitts

reviews.title: Short Journey in the Caribbean
reviews.text: The Caribbean is well known for inter island flights on most airlines not being on time or there also being other issues. I thought this 15 minute journey was not only an experience (with a very short runway on Saba) but it was broadly on time and completely in line with my expectations. People also have to remember that Princess Juliana airport on St Maarten suffered badly under Hurricane Irma and they are doing the best they can with bringing it back up to full speed.
reviews.author: Graham A

reviews.title: An experience.
reviews.text: We flew from St Marteen to St Barth’s. We waited with anticipation as we prepared to land on one of the most dangerous airports in the world. Had a 50/50 chance of landing on the hill side. We really wanted the experience. As luck would have it, we got our wish. The landing was everything we expected and just as shown on YouTube and other social media sites; excitingly frightening (just a bit). The pilots seemed quite experienced and there were no issues. As expected on a small plane, the seats were cramped and it was very warm. Thankfully it was only a 15 min flight or so. Oddly, they lost our luggage on the way up...there were only about 10 people on board. Apparently, it was on the flight ahead of us and sat around for an hour. Got some terrific pictures for this review.
reviews.author: Kevin S.
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Day trip to St. Barts
reviews.text: We had a beautiful flight over from St. Martin and enjoyed our day there. Upon arriving back at the airport, we were told that the flight back was cancelled due to wind. We were forced to take the ferry back which was extremely rough as well as rude management in the boarding process. We reported the canceled flight to our Concierge at our hotel and theyassisted us in requesting a refund of the cancelled flight. Winair told our Concierge that we would receive an email regarding a refund but we never did.
reviews.author: Klewis1
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Maybe lucky?
reviews.text: Well... maybe we were lucky? Knowing the catastrophic level of airlines services in the Caribbean that is well possible, but we had two flights with Winair, they were on time, service at the airport was average but ok and they didn't loose our bags... I guess it's difficult to ask for more in this part of the world. Plus remarkable landing in Saba, even with an Otter it's something!!
reviews.author: JMGeneva

reviews.title: Great Airline
reviews.text: I recently flew this airline from St. Barts to St. Maarten expert pilots I do not recommend St. Bart Commuter they cancelled my flight because I was the only person booked that morning had to wait 2hrs for the next available flight on Winair they are very reliable and have more flights daily they are the better choice

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: A delay of 2,5 hours from Curacao to Bonaire, which is a flight duration of only 20 minutes. When going back, another delay of 3 hours without notifying. Never, never never book with winair when you can choose another option.
reviews.author: amber

reviews.title: Didn't know ponctuality
reviews.text: Really bad flight company. Never on time. No informations send about delayed flight. More expensiv than other company (divi divi air for exemple). If you flight Between ABC island, chose another company
reviews.author: Bastien G

reviews.title: Just terrible!
reviews.text: Our flight was cancelled. First they made us wait 2hrs without providing any information then they couldnt find our luggage which had been checked in already. Staff is rude and doesnt have a clue about their work. Eventually they let us know that there wont be any flight. As compensation they brought us to the worst hotel in town. The next day started with another delay. so if you are in for a terrible trip book Winair.
reviews.author: John Johnsson

reviews.title: Delay of 4 hours, and coming back to the airport in time, another delay for 3 hours...
reviews.text: Not sure whether I will be able to leave at all today. Information given to passengers is extremely poor and late. What a drama!
reviews.author: Bob Horváth

reviews.title: Puddle jumping
reviews.text: Day trip to visit our son doing an internship on Statia, lovely experience flying in a small plane, brief stop on Saba was exhilarating
reviews.author: Kevin R
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Eustatius

reviews.title: Lost luggage=horrible vacation
reviews.text: Checked In and unfriendly counter agent made me check my bag. Arrive in ANU and their are 7 other and I passengers of the 16 that were on the flight that received no bags. Seems like the previous day they overbooked the flight and the overbooked passengers luggage bumped ours. With that being the only flight of the day, had to stay in same clothes for over 30 hours and no personal items (shaver, toothbrush, toothpaste, etc.) The ANU agent told us all, "oh they do this almost everyday." Not cheap either. They always use the excuse of a weight restriction even though there are empty seats. NEVER will fly them again!
reviews.author: nocurfu53

reviews.title: Good Service and Flight
reviews.text: Ground Staff was really nice. The flight was fun and on time. We got our baggage fast. Everything went great:)
reviews.author: Antonia S

reviews.title: On time .... made every connection!
reviews.text: Made all connections and my baggage too! My trip consisted of three legs with the first departing at 08:30 and the last departing at 16:50. This was for a total trip time of 8.5 hours. The staff at the 3rd leg suggested an earlier connection and my total trip time was reduced to 5.75 hours. Thanks team WINAIR.

reviews.title: good flight to Aruba
reviews.text: Comfortable flight. Friendly staff. flight had a slight delay on the way down but was on time on the return flight.
reviews.author: Marco L

reviews.title: It was a good flight
reviews.text: It was a good flight. The flight attendant was really nice. We were serve a small snack on the 2 hour flight.
reviews.author: Chesley Augustine

reviews.title: Very basic and desorganizad but takes you from a to b
reviews.text: This is your typical very basic (not cheap) Caribbean airline than hoops from island to island in a strange predictable disorganised way. Good to take you from a to b but that is it
reviews.author: Ricardo B

reviews.title: Timely
reviews.text: Our flight from SanJuan was delayed and they waited for us in their last flight to St. Barth’s and our return flight was on time. So no complaints on the ten minutes flight.
reviews.author: frankiecatala
reviews.route: St Martin / St Maarten - St. Barthelemy

reviews.title: Non existent flight
reviews.text: 2 weeks away from my trip it appears my flight doesn’t exist. Bought it thru Priceline weeks ago, but now the flight appears to be cancelled. My confirmation code gives a trip itenarary but a search of the site reveals no flight. I’ve emailed them but no response.
reviews.author: FRED NICE
